aboutGame.title: What is Vision Quest?
paragraphs: Vision Quest is Marvel Studios' eight-episode Disney+ series built around Vision, the synthezoid Avenger played by Paul Bettany. Picking up the thread left dangling at the end of WandaVision, it follows a rebuilt, memory-wiped White Vision as he hides in a Scottish pub and tries to work out who he is by consulting the AI personas still embedded in his programming, including J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y. and James Spader's returning Ultron.

When a bounty is placed on his head, Vision goes on the run with Thomas Shepherd, a boy who may be his son, and the quiet character study turns into a chase thriller. Our wiki breaks down every episode, the confirmed cast, the MCU timeline placement, the Easter eggs, and how the finale sets up Avengers: Doomsday.

faq.title: Vision Quest FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Marvel's Vision Quest series on Disney+.

items.question: What is Vision Quest about?
items.answer: Vision Quest follows a rebuilt, memory-wiped White Vision as he hides in a Scottish pub and tries to understand who he is by talking to the AI personas inside his programming, including J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y. and Ultron. When a bounty is placed on his head, the quiet character study becomes a chase thriller.

items.question: When does Vision Quest premiere and how many episodes are there?
items.answer: Vision Quest premieres with two episodes on Disney+ on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, and runs for eight episodes, closing with the season finale on November 10, 2026.

items.question: Where can I watch Vision Quest?
items.answer: Vision Quest streams exclusively on Disney+. New episodes arrive Tuesdays at 9 p.m. ET in the U.S., which is early Wednesday morning in the UK and Europe.

items.question: Do I need to watch WandaVision before Vision Quest?
items.answer: Yes. Vision Quest picks up the thread from WandaVision, where White Vision's memories were restored and he left Westview to find himself. Agatha All Along is optional, but it fills in the wider Maximoff family story.

items.question: Is Vision Quest connected to Avengers: Doomsday?
items.answer: Vision Quest is a Phase Six series that feeds directly into Avengers: Doomsday, and its finale keeps the Young Avengers thread around Tommy Maximoff open for what comes next.
